summary: REGENXBIO filed an 8-K reporting a September 23, 2026 Settlement Agreement with The Trustees of the University of Pennsylvania and Sarepta Therapeutics, Inc./Sarepta Therapeutics Three, LLC, joined by Catalent, resolving patent infringement litigation over U.S. Patent Nos. 10,526,617 and 11,680,274 tied to Sarepta's SRP-9001 (ELEVIDYS). Sarepta pays $39.0 million within 10 days; all suits terminate with prejudice. REGENXBIO grants a covenant not to sue for AAVrh74-capsid gene therapies and existing ELEVIDYS, with limited scope. Agreement to be filed with Q3 2026 Form 10-Q. Watch cash recognition and residual patent scope.
